text.tspan: Share of calories from cereals, roots, and tubers vs. GDP per capita 2021
A high share of calories from cereals, roots and tubers typically represents lower dietary diversity. GDP per
capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Calories from cereals, roots and tubers (percent)

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
